big: Most futures losses come from size, not from being wrong about direction. A trader who risks 1% of capital per trade can be wrong many times and still be in the game. One who bets half the account cannot.

lines: What matters most when trading futures?

Position sizing: how much you risk per trade. A stop-loss limits the loss but does not guarantee the exit price. Rollover keeps exposure going past expiry. This lesson is about risk, not about calls to trade.
